MORE:
Further to our letter no. TAI/SEC/SEBI- LODR/26-27/177, dated 2nd November, 2026, we hereby inform that the Board in its Meeting held today, i.e., 10th November, 2026, has approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter / half year ended 30th September, 2026.

Please find enclosed the following:
1. Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter / half year ended 30th September, 2026.
2. Limited Review Report on the Financial Statement for the quarter / half year ended 30th September, 2026.

The Board Meeting held today commenced at 03.00. p.m. and concluded at 04.30 p.m.
Kindly take the same on record.
